regions.region: graphical abstract reaction arrow beneath ABSTRACT
regions.finding: Generic Rh(I)-mediated conversion of substituted 1,5-bisallene 6 to seven-membered triene 7 with a reported 48-78% family-level yield range; classified as a general scheme, not an individual experiment.

regions.region: abstract text and two-column introductory discussion
regions.finding: Abstract states the new cycloisomerization pattern and proposed beta-H/reductive-elimination sequence; introductory citations describe prior literature and were not imported as present-paper experiments.

unresolved: The graphical abstract uses generic X and R groups, so complete structures and an individual reaction identity cannot be assigned.
The arrow omits solvent identity, time, temperature, atmosphere, workup, purification, and yield basis.

regions.finding: Three distinct branches were inspected: prior Rh(I) and Pd(0) pathways were classified as literature examples, and the generic [M] to 5 pathway as a conceptual general scheme; none was treated as a fully specified present-paper experiment.

Two distinct conditions were recorded: 5 mol% trans-RhCl(CO)(PPh3)2 in refluxing toluene gave trace 7a plus unidentified bimolecular products, while 2 mol% [RhCl(CO)2]2 in toluene at 80 °C and 0.0417 M gave isolated 7a in 30% yield.

regions.region: Table 1 at upper right, including footnotes a-e
regions.finding: All nine solvent/catalyst optimization rows were transcribed as independent records with row-specific time, yield, scale, catalyst/ligand exceptions, and the 100 °C overrides for DMF and DMA.

regions.region: right-column Table 1 discussion and lower-right Table 2 scope preview
regions.finding: Narrative evidence for Table 2 entries 1-9 was merged into the corresponding page-3 row records rather than duplicated; the prose/table conflict for condition-A 6b (prose says 7a with lower purity, table reports 7b) is retained unresolved.

unresolved: Table 1 prints 'yield of 4a (%)' while the surrounding prose identifies the product as 7a; values were preserved with the conflict noted.
Table 1 entries 1-6 specify 2 mol% rhodium catalyst but the footnote does not name that catalyst explicitly.
Most experimental rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and yield measurement basis.
Complex substrate/product structures were not independently verified.

regions.region: Table 2 at upper left, including reaction drawing and footnotes a-i
regions.finding: All ten substrate-scope rows were recorded independently. Conditions A/B/C, time, scale, concentration, catalyst/ligand loading, solvent, temperature, product yield, 7/7-prime ratios, not-observed 7-prime outcomes, <5% if-any statements, and the two 84% ee values were preserved and linked to their entities.

regions.region: Scheme 2 at upper right and mechanism prose below Table 2
regions.finding: The 6a to M1 to M2 to 7a cycle was classified as a possible mechanism with cyclometalation, beta-H elimination, and reductive elimination steps, not as an additional experiment.

regions.region: Note Added after ASAP Publication and Supporting Information Available statement
regions.finding: The source notes earlier Table 2/SI numbering corrections and states that SI is available online. No SI file was provided or explicitly associated, so no SI facts were imported.

unresolved: The compact substituent placement for Table 2 entries 3 and 4 could not be assigned confidently to both R columns from the supplied page alone.
Complex substrate/product and organometallic-intermediate structures remain unverified; SMILES were intentionally left null.
The SI availability statement does not establish a supplied SI association, so experimental procedures, workup, purification, characterization, and yield bases remain missing.
